valid.portia-work-event.json: Exact Portia Event representation used as judgment material.
valid.portia-record-account.json: Exact Account representation used as judgment evidence.
valid.portia-record-observation.json: Exact Observation representation used as judgment evidence.
valid.module-record.json: Typed sibling-module record with explicit supported contract version.
valid.module-record-version-unknown.json: Typed sibling-module record retains explicit null contract version without treating null as a wildcard.

invalid.raw-source-artifact-branch.json: Raw source artifacts are not direct judgment-evidence branches.
invalid.module-record-portia-overlap.json: Portia records must use the exact Portia branch, not the sibling-module branch.
invalid.portia-work-null-version.json: Exact Portia work references require a non-null contract version.
invalid.portia-record-null-record-version.json: Exact Portia child-record references require a non-null record contract version.
invalid.module-record-missing-wrapper.json: Module records require the complete module_work_record_ref wrapper.
invalid.embedded-payload.json: Judgment evidence references cannot embed substantive evidence content.

application_invalid.module-id-mismatch.json: The Core-shaped work and record references name different sibling modules.
